notes:
aurora_lint 1504 (v0.5.3 step 3), valkey EXP19-C stratum S2, batch 30: a baseline, not a delta. Continues dev-149's b01-b18 from its handoff plan (run-274 keys). Stacked on delta-1504-valkey-exp19c-s2-b29; this branch adds only this batch's rows over its parent.

SCOPE. S2 is every in-scope valkey EXP19-C key at realworld run 274 that is not else-shaped and has no preprocessor directive within the next 5 lines. Brandon ruled that S2 is labeled by hand rather than by a mechanical checker. This batch: 127 keys in 1 file(s), src/rdb.c:86 .. src/rdb.c:1374 (if 127).

STANDARD. The existing EXP19-C convention: TP when the body of the if/for/while/do at that line is a single statement not enclosed in braces; FP only when the premise is false and the body is a braced block the tool misread.

METHOD. The adjudicator read every key's construct at source in the pinned checkout and wrote each verdict and body token by hand; no script decided a verdict. A formatter then checked that each reason's named body token is present at the key.

RESULT: 127 TP.

Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision/recall claim is made here.
